other_scope: Descriptive registered probes including signed/scale and frozen-source controls; no independent generalization inference

units.scaled_jacobian: max scaled component error over a unit tangent at unit coefficient norm (row 2-norm)
units.relative_jacobian: Frobenius error / native Frobenius; null for zero reference
units.accepted_direction_relative: L2 error in Jv / native ||Jv|| for an actual outgoing accepted geodesic direction
units.percentiles: query-level linear interpolation, same query IDs per paired method
